profile.name: Deiva mani Kailasam
profile.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
profile.bio: Passionate and detail-oriented Senior Full Stack Developer with 8+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying robust web applications and end-to-end solutions. Expert in modern technologies and cloud platforms, committed to clean code, best practices, and delivering tangible business value. Proven leader in independently managing projects, mentoring junior developers, resolving complex technical challenges, and contributing effectively within Agile teams. Strong expertise in AI innovation, integrating intelligent features and automation using cutting-edge AI technologies. Dedicated to continuous learning, driving innovation, optimizing development workflows, and building scalable, user-friendly software products that exceed expectations.

points: Architected and led delivery of a multi-module Spring Boot 3.x microservices platform with JWT/OAuth2 security, multi-tenant data access, and OpenAPI/Swagger documentation. Integrated Angular, React.js, Next.js frontends with Python data pipelines and MongoDB analytics stores. Platform served 50,000+ daily API requests across hybrid SQL/NoSQL architectures

Designed scalable hybrid data access layer supporting PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Snowflake, MongoDB with Liquibase-managed SQL migrations and MongoDB schema versioning, enabling seamless cross-database support, real-time Gen AI embeddings, and query complexity reduction

Owned full-stack system architecture from database design (SQL + MongoDB) through REST/gRPC API specification to Angular/React.js/Next.js frontend implementation with GitOps workflows, ensuring architectural consistency across 12+ feature modules and multi-framework frontend ecosystem

Implemented gRPC-based plugin architecture for client module integration with Python microservices and customizable React dashboard plugins, improving system extensibility and enabling faster service onboarding
API performance optimization and reduced database load by designing a hybrid caching layer with Caffeine, Redis, and MongoDB

Built and maintained production-grade design system with 40+ reusable UI components across Angular, React.js, Next.js (data tables, charts, forms, modals) distributed via private Nexus npm registry and Git submodules, supporting 6 internal products with framework-agnostic design tokens

Implemented advanced table capabilities with AG Grid Enterprise across Angular/React.js/Next.js: multi-column filtering, sorting, selection, pagination, row expansion, custom cell rendering, CSV/Excel export via ExcelJS, and Gen AI-powered data insights, enabling non-technical users to analyze data independently

Designed and shipped white-label theming system supporting 5+ brand variants with dynamic stylesheet injection across Angular SCSS + React.js/Next.js Tailwind, Storybook preview switching, reducing theme configuration effort

Authored comprehensive Storybook documentation (Angular + React.js/Next.js + MDX + Compodoc) with 150+ component stories, custom preview themes, Gen AI component suggestions, and a11y testing addons, increasing discoverability by 85%

Created 15+ custom form validators (Angular ReactiveForms + React Hook Form) with reusable validation service and Python backend validation, eliminating 90% manual form error handling across frameworks
Built cross-framework directive/hooks library (Angular directives + React custom hooks + Next.js HOCs), Gen AI autocomplete, reducing code duplication across Angular/React.js/Next.js

Implemented multi-tenant data access patterns with database-per-tenant (PostgreSQL/SQL Server) + MongoDB collection-per-tenant, row-level security, supporting 12 concurrent environments with zero cross-tenant leakage and Gen AI tenant embeddings

Built comprehensive REST/gRPC API surface (75+ Spring Boot endpoints, 50+ Python FastAPI endpoints) for onboarding, data backfill, quality monitoring, Gen AI analytics, MongoDB aggregation pipelines; OpenAPI contracts with 100% coverage

Integrated external platforms (Google Ads, Meta/Facebook, Bing Ads, Adverity, Snowflake, Power BI) + MongoDB Atlas Search with OAuth2/OIDC, Python data connectors, Gen AI RAG pipelines, enabling real-time advertising analytics
Developed data quality scoring engine with Python ML models, MongoDB aggregation, business KPIs, Gen AI anomaly detection, flagging issues in real-time, reducing undetected data quality issues by 75%
Implemented large payload handling with Spring WebClient + Python asyncio, MongoDB GridFS, virtual threads, parallel query execution, improving 99th percentile latency by 55%

Established test infrastructure spanning 1000+ unit tests (Jest + Vitest + Pytest), 100+ integration tests (Cypress + Playwright), controller-level tests (MockMvc + Python pytest), MongoDB test containers, Allure reporting, achieving 80+% coverage across Java/Python/UI

Configured CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins (Groovy) with GitHub Actions for React.js/Next.js, PR validation, Docker multi-stage builds (Java + Python + Node), SonarQube gates, reducing merge-to-deploy by 40%
Implemented structured logging via Logback (Java) + structlog (Python), Datadog aggregation, MongoDB performance dashboards, correlation-based debugging across microservices + serverless functions
Enforced code quality with ESLint (Angular/React.js/Next.js), Stylelint, Pylint/Black, custom SonarQube rules, maintaining A-grade scores across multi-language codebase

Designed Kubernetes infrastructure with Deployment manifests for Spring Boot + Python FastAPI + Next.js, Service discovery, ConfigMaps, Vault + Git credentials, MongoDB StatefulSets, reducing config burden by 80%
Built multi-stage Docker builds for Java backend (OpenJDK 21 + Elastic APM), Python services, Angular/React.js/Next.js (Node 22 + Nginx), MongoDB backup sidecars, 45% image size reduction
Developed Terraform IaC for AWS ECS/Fargate + MongoDB Atlas, GitOps with ArgoCD, infrastructure versioning, one-command deployments, 100% manual change elimination
Automated Docker publishing to Nexus (npm + Docker + PyPI), Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Git tags, blue-green + canary deployments for zero-downtime across Java/Python/JS stacks
Configured K8s probes (liveness/readiness/startup) + MongoDB health checks, Python service readiness, reducing MTTR by 65%

Led technical design reviews for 8+ feature modules across Spring Boot + Python + React.js/Next.js, establishing patterns (abstract service layer, saga pattern, CQRS, Gen AI service mesh), 500K+ daily users

Mentored 5+ junior engineers in Angular/React.js/Next.js best practices, Spring Boot + Python patterns, MongoDB optimization, Git workflows, Gen AI integration, 3 promoted to mid-level within 18 months
Defined/enforced coding standards through multi-language code review (Java/Python/JS), automated linting (ESLint + Pylint), Git hooks, PR templates, production bug reduction
Conducted brown-bag sessions on caching strategies, microservices, Kubernetes, MongoDB aggregation, React.js/Next.js SSR, Gen AI prompt engineering, GitOps best practices
Collaborated with product/design to translate requirements into specs for 6 major features (multi-framework frontend + Gen AI backend) with full test coverage, zero critical issues

Architected and owned end-to-end delivery of a Progressive Web App (PWA) for construction company operations, serving internal field teams, office staff, and executives with 100% mobile-responsive design supporting offline-first capabilities across attendance tracking, contract management, employee lifecycle, and operational workflows

Designed scalable full-stack architecture using Angular frontend, Node.js/Express backend, gRPC microservices, PostgreSQL with complex relational schemas, and Azure cloud infrastructure, handling 200+ daily active users across 10+ construction sites with 99.9% uptime
Led direct technical discussions with company owner and other executives, translating business requirements into technical roadmaps and ROI-focused solutions, delivering 3 major feature releases

Built production-grade Angular application with PWA capabilities (Service Workers, App Manifest, Cache API) enabling full offline functionality for field workers, reducing data connectivity dependency by 85% and improving daily task completion rates by 40%

Implemented responsive design system supporting mobile-first workflows for construction site supervisors (tablets/phones) and desktop dashboards for office management, using Angular Material, PrimeNG, CSS Grid/Flexbox, and mobile-first SCSS architecture with 100% viewport coverage across devices

Developed complex Angular feature modules for Employee Management (onboarding, timesheets, certifications), Contract Tracking (milestones, payments, change orders), Attendance & Scheduling (GPS check-ins, shift rostering), and Document Management (RFIs, submittals, safety forms), serving 200+ employees across multiple project sites

Architected Node.js/Express backend with gRPC microservices for high performance data operations, implementing stream processing for real-time timesheet validation, contract milestone updates, and employee availability syncing, achieving sub-100ms response times for 95th percentile requests

Designed sophisticated PostgreSQL schemas supporting complex relationships between Employees, Projects, Contracts, Timesheets, Certifications, Safety Incidents, with JSONB fields for flexible document storage and full text search for rapid document retrieval

Implemented robust business logic including timesheet approval workflows, contract payment schedules, employee certification expiry tracking, overtime calculation, and project cost-to-complete forecasting

Deployed full platform to Azure using Azure App Service, Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Azure Functions for scheduled jobs, Azure Blob Storage for construction documents, and Azure AD B2C for employee authentication, achieving zero-downtime deployments and auto-scaling during peak payroll periods

Built complete CI/CD pipeline with Azure DevOps (YAML pipelines), multi-stage Docker builds, Azure Container Registry, and infrastructure-as-code via ARM templates and Bicep, reducing deployment time from 2 hours to 12 minutes (94% improvement)

Implemented Azure monitoring stack with Application Insights, Log Analytics, Azure Monitor alerts, and custom dashboards tracking API performance, database query latency, PWA cache hit rates, and user session analytics, enabling proactive issue resolution with reduction in MTTR
Directly influenced product roadmap through weekly executive syncs with company owner, proposing and implementing high ROI features that improved operational efficiency and reduced payroll disputes

Delivered measurable ROI including annual savings from payroll automation, business savings from timesheet digitization (paperless), reduction in overtime overpayments, and 3x faster compliance reporting for WorkSafe Victoria audits

Achieved 100% user adoption across construction, admin, and executive teams through collaborative UX design, field testing with site supervisors, and progressive feature rollouts, eliminating resistance to digital transformation in traditionally paper-based industry

Established engineering standards for TypeScript, Angular architecture, Node.js patterns, gRPC protobuf contracts, and PostgreSQL optimization, creating reusable patterns that accelerated feature development by 45% for subsequent hires
Implemented comprehensive testing strategy with Jest (95% unit test coverage), Cypress E2E tests, Postman API collections for gRPC endpoints, and Azure Load Testing, ensuring zero critical bugs
Architected data migration strategy converting years of legacy data into PostgreSQL with data validation, duplicate detection, and incremental migration
Led migration of legacy Spring MVC monolith to Spring MVC + Spring Boot architecture, reducing technical debt by 70% and eliminating 15+ critical security vulnerabilities from unsupported Spring

Refactored 50K+ lines of legacy Spring code into Spring Boot layered architecture (Repository → Service → REST Controller) using Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, and Thymeleaf templates, improving maintainability and reducing bug fix time

Implemented Spring design patterns including @Service, @Repository, @RestController, and DTO patterns, establishing maintainable RESTful foundation that supported 3x faster feature development for subsequent team members

Migrated from AngularJS 1.5 to Angular 5 gradually and developed responsive Angular frontend integrated with Spring Boot REST endpoints, delivering employee dashboard, project tracking, and reporting modules with mobile responsiveness across tablets and desktops, eliminating AngularJS security vulnerabilities and improving bundle size by 65%

Migrated 20+ AngularJS controllers/directives to Angular 5 components/services, implementing RxJS Observables, Angular Router, Angular Material, and lazy loading, achieving 3x faster initial page loads and 85% reduction in memory leaks
Created RESTful APIs in Spring Boot using Spring Web MVC with Jackson JSON serialization, CORS handling, and Spring Security OAuth2, supporting Angular HTTP Client calls with token validation

Designed PostgreSQL schemas replacing legacy Oracle, implementing normalized models for projects, employees, timesheets, billing with stored procedures, triggers, and indexes, reducing query execution time by 65%
Migrated 100K+ legacy records using custom ETL scripts, data validation rules, achieving data accuracy and zero downtime
Optimized database performance through query refactoring, composite indexing, pagination, reducing page load times
Implemented test-first development with JUnit, Mockito, TestNG, Spring for 85% unit test coverage across Spring Boot services and repositories
Developed Selenium WebDriver tests for Angular E2E workflows, achieving 100% automation for critical journeys catching 25+ regressions
Integrated SonarQube into Maven, enforcing quality gates, maintaining A-grade score
Containerized Spring Boot app using Docker, multi-stage builds (Maven + OpenJDK 8 + embedded Tomcat), reducing package size
Delivered 8+ major releases, eliminating complex workflows and manual work, consolidating all systems
Real-time Angular 5 developer-only dashboards for testing status of APIs
Delivered company-wide town hall presentation (2018) on telecom domain modernization, educating 150+ employees on our project

education.description: Comprehensive postgraduate program focusing on advanced software engineering, enterprise systems, and emerging technologies. Key coursework included: Software Engineering Methodologies, Database Design and Implementation, Web Application Development, Network Security and Cryptography, Cloud Computing, Project Management, Research Methods, and IT Strategy. Completed capstone project on scalable web application architecture. Graduated with distinction, demonstrating expertise in modern software development practices and enterprise-level system design.

Four-year undergraduate program in Information Technology covering fundamental and advanced computing concepts. Core subjects included: Programming Languages (C, C++, Java), Data Structures and Algorithms, Database Management Systems, Computer Networks, Operating Systems, Software Engineering, Web Technologies, Object-Oriented Programming, Computer Architecture, and Software Testing. Completed final year project on web-based application development. Graduated with honors, establishing strong foundation in computer science principles and software development methodologies.

projects.title: ATS Resume Optimizer
projects.description: An AI-powered resume optimization tool that intelligently adapts resumes to specific job descriptions for maximum ATS compatibility. Uses OpenAI GPT-4o-mini with 14 distinct ATS strategies, programmatic keyword verification, iterative refinement, and 40 premium themes with live preview and PDF export.
highlights: 14 ATS optimization strategies including keyword frequency, semantic skill clustering, and STAR-style bullets
Programmatic keyword verification with computed match % separate from LLM scoring
40 premium resume themes with configurable accent colors and live preview
Job URL scraping supporting Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, LinkedIn, and Indeed
Iterative refinement with up to N optimization passes tracking missing keywords and scores
PDF export via headless Chromium with A4 formatting

projects.title: Dynamic Task Scheduler
projects.description: An AI task-scheduling agent that accepts natural-language task descriptions with deadlines, durations, meetings, and energy constraints, then uses OpenAI GPT-4o to produce prioritized, time-blocked schedules with markdown table exports.
highlights: Natural language input for tasks, deadlines, durations, and energy constraints
GPT-4o powered scheduling with urgency, importance, and constraint awareness
Markdown table export with smart section grouping for identical schedules
CLI and programmatic usage with rate limit and quota handling

projects.title: Helio Supervisor
projects.description: A hierarchical supervisor agent for goal-oriented workflows supporting multiple LLM providers, RAG over local documents, and six built-in tools. Features both a Streamlit web UI and a Rich CLI with optional human-in-the-loop approval and persistent conversation memory.
highlights: Multi-provider LLM support — OpenAI, Ollama (local), Google Gemini, Perplexity
Six built-in tools: plan_tasks, web_fetch, code_exec, write_note, summarize_text, rag_search
RAG over local documents using FAISS + BGE embeddings with optional offline mode
Human-in-the-loop approval for code execution, web fetch, and note writing
Dual interfaces — Streamlit web UI and Rich CLI with shared supervisor logic
Persistent JSONL conversation log and agent-written notes

projects.title: Legal Researcher Pro
projects.description: A Streamlit-based legal research and summarization tool where users paste clauses or legal questions, choose a jurisdiction (Australia, USA, or India), and receive structured analysis with confidence scoring and recommended next steps powered by GPT-4o.
highlights: Jurisdiction-aware research supporting Australian, USA, and Indian law
Structured JSON output with legal analysis, confidence score, and recommended next steps
Citation integrity enforcement — no fabricated cases or statutes
Neutral multi-perspective analysis with explicit uncertainty handling
Color-coded confidence badges (high/medium/low) in a legal-themed dark UI

projects.title: Self-Critiquing Planner
projects.description: A Streamlit app that converts high-level goals into structured plans using GPT-4o, runs a second GPT-4o pass to critique them, and supports human review and simulated execution through a Planner-Critic-Human-Executor pipeline with adaptive session memory.
highlights: Goal-to-plan decomposition with structured JSON steps including type and risk assessment
Second-pass GPT-4o critique for gaps, ambiguity, risk, and safety analysis
Human-in-the-loop plan editing and step-level approval before execution
Simulated execution engine for shell, code, manual, and plan-type steps
Session memory with adaptive context for improved future planning
Domain presets — Code Refactor, Learning Plan, Workflow Design, Generic
